content.en: Money serves three primary functions: **Medium of Exchange**, which eliminates the need for double coincidence of wants; **Unit of Account**, providing a common measure for the value of goods; and **Store of Value**, allowing purchasing power to be saved for future use. Additionally, it acts as a **Standard of Deferred Payment**.
